description: Files that are syntactically valid JSON but not a catalog at the top level (array, string, number, null), and files that are blank or nearly blank (all four characters the loader counts as JSON whitespace, an empty file, and a single U+00A0 which it does NOT count) -- plus an empty JSON object as the control that loads. Written verbatim because a top-level non-object cannot be expressed through the locale-keyed files map.
